description: This is a base class for testing Orleans reminder functionality. It provides common utilities and test operations such as starting, stopping, and listing reminders, as well as various test scenarios for reminders in a distributed Orleans cluster context.

classes.name: ReminderTests_Base
classes.description: Provides a common base for reminder-related tests, including setup, teardown, and utility methods for interacting with reminders.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up reminder tables via a grain proxy.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_1J_MultiGrainMultiReminders
methods.description: Runs churn tests with multiple grains and reminders, including adding additional silos.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_ReminderNotFound
methods.description: Verifies behavior when requesting a non-existent reminder.

methods.name: PerGrainMultiReminderTestChurn
methods.description: Performs reminder churn tests on a specific grain.

methods.name: PerGrainFailureTest
methods.description: Tests behavior when a reminder fails.

methods.name: PerGrainMultiReminderTest
methods.description: Executes a comprehensive multi-reminder churn test scenario.

methods.name: PerCopyGrainFailureTest
methods.description: Tests failure behavior on a copy-based grain reminder.

methods.name: AssertIsInRange
methods.description: Asserts that a value falls within an expected range, logs detailed info.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetries
methods.description: Retries a function multiple times with delay and error handling.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetriesStop
methods.description: Retries a stop operation with error handling.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Handles exceptions during retries, especially ReminderException.
